subject: Capacity uplift and annual renewal — proposed tier reconfiguration
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@flickercommerce.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity uplift and annual renewal — proposed tier reconfiguration

Hi Eleanor,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — great to hear how Flicker Commerce's new personalization pipeline is driving higher inference volumes. Per our discussion, you indicated interest in moving from your current hosted monthly commit (1.2M tokens/month) to a higher committed tier to stabilize unit pricing and unlock a larger burst window for peak traffic.

To make the renewal conversation concrete, I'm proposing two options we can present to procurement:

- Option A — Stability Tier: 2.5M monthly commit, 3x burst bucket, 10% discount on per-token rate vs current.
- Option B — Growth Tier: 4.5M monthly commit, 5x burst bucket, 18% discount on per-token rate, and 2-week priority provisioning during calendar Q1 launch windows.

Key notes: both options include the same SLA baseline and access to our Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization suggestions) to help reduce effective unit cost. I attached a short usage export so you can verify the commit proposal against your recent run rate.

Ask from you: could you confirm which option you prefer (A or B) and whether procurement will need a recommended SOW/statement of work to include with the PO? If you want, we can provide a pro-forma invoice and SOW draft for internal review.

Next steps from Redwood: Vanessa and I will price the SOW and suggest an implementation timeline (model pinning, routing, and a 2-week ramp plan).

Attachments: usage_report_dec2026.csv (csv)

Best,

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@flickercommerce.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift and annual renewal — proposed tier reconfiguration

Sergio,

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with what our engineering lead expected. A couple of clarifying items from procurement and ops:

- Procurement would prefer to lock a 12-month term, but they'd like the option to tier up mid-term if traffic grows faster than forecast. Is there a simple addendum flow for mid-term uplifts or do we need a full amendment?
- For billing, can you confirm whether the burst bucket credit can be reallocated month-to-month across projects (we run three services under the same account)?
- We will need a short SOW (1–2 pages) to attach to the PO — can you include a paragraph on migration steps and expected latency/availability impact?

We are leaning toward Option B given the upcoming Q1 push, but we need a clear path for a mid-term bridge and final pricing for the Growth Tier (line-item: monthly committed tokens, overage rate, burst window, and any prorated month rules).

CC: billing@flickercommerce.com for procurement visibility.

Cheers,

Eleanor Park
Head of Platform Engineering | Flicker Commerce
eleanor@flickercommerce.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@flickercommerce.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift and annual renewal — proposed tier reconfiguration

Eleanor — looping in Vanessa (Customer Success) and Karthik (Pricing/Product) to provide the detailed answers and a draft SOW.

On Fri, Dec 4, 2026 at 09:18, Eleanor Park <eleanor@flickercommerce.com> wrote:
> Sergio,
>
> Thanks — this is helpful ... we are leaning toward Option B given the upcoming Q1 push ...

Vanessa / Karthik — summary and asks below:

- Flicker is planning to annualize at higher committed tokens. They want Growth Tier numbers (4.5M monthly commit), clear overage rates, and the ability to scale mid-term without starting a full contract renegotiation.
- They operate 3 services under the same account and want burst bucket credits to be poolable across projects.
- Procurement needs a short SOW and a pro-forma invoice to attach to the PO.

Proposed internal approach:
1) Provide a Growth Tier proposal with exact line-item pricing (monthly commit, per-token rate, overage per-1k tokens, burst_bucket size and reallocation rules).
2) Draft a 2-page SOW that outlines implementation steps: model pin from v3.2, traffic routing update (canary -> 50% for 48 hours -> 100%), and a 2-week ramp with monitoring hooks.
3) Add a mid-term addendum clause: simple uplift path that triggers a 30-day billing proration and does not change other SLA terms.

Attachments I am including for your review: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf), AWS_cost_model.xlsx (xlsx).

Vanessa / Karthik — can you turn around a pricing sheet + SOW markup by EOD Wednesday so I can share with Flicker procurement and Eleanor's billing contact?

Thanks,

Sergio

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift and annual renewal — proposed tier reconfiguration

Sergio / Vanessa — pricing and next steps below.

On Mon, Dec 6, 2026 at 11:05, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vanessa / Karthik — summary and asks below:

Pricing (Growth Tier — proposed):
- Monthly committed tokens: 4.5M
- Committed per-token rate: $0.00090/token (18% off your current effective rate)
- Overage rate: $0.00125/token billed in 1k-token increments
- Burst window: 5x monthly commit (shared across projects)
- Mid-term uplift: allowed via a 30-day addendum; billing prorated on an effective daily basis; no change to SLA or priority provisioning terms.

SOW highlights (we distilled to 2 pages):
- Objectives: commit uplift, routing pin, ramp plan, monitoring hooks.
- Timeline: 2 weeks to production after signature (week 0 — SOW & PO; week 1 — initial pin & canary; week 2 — full ramp and follow-up evaluation).
- Signoffs: Flicker Eng lead, Flicker Procurement, Redwood CS (Vanessa).

Procurement notes:
- We will provide a pro-forma invoice and the 2-page SOW; procurement can attach both to their PO.
- For billing: burst credits will be poolable across projects under the same account id; we'll note the pooling rule in the SOW and invoice.

Next actions:
1) Sergio — share Growth Tier pricing + SOW with Eleanor and billing@flickercommerce.com.
2) Vanessa — prepare the finalized 2-page SOW and push the SOW + pro-forma invoice to DocuSign (link below).
3) Eleanor / Flicker — confirm Option B / Growth Tier and return signed PO or DocuSign signature.

DocuSign (pro-forma link): https://www.docusign.net/link/ABC1234

Karthik Iyer
Head of Pricing & Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
